newsitem.title: JAPAN: Bridgestone's profit to hit record in 1997 - paper.
newsitem.headline: Bridgestone's profit to hit record in 1997 - paper.

text.p: Bridgestone Corp is expected to post parent current profit of 95 billion yen in the year ending in December 1997, registering two consecutive years of record profits, a Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported over the weekend.
The company's earnings will be buoyed mainly by robust demand for repair tyres and non-tyre products for the office equipment and construction sectors, the paper reported on Saturday.
Meanwhile, the company's export revenues are expected to decline about 7 percent due to the shift of part of production to its subsidiary and a decline in revenues in Europe, the paper said.
The company's parent sales in 1997 will likely rise slightly from the previous year to 720 billion yen, the paper said.
The company's parent sales in the year ended on December 31 are expected to have totaled 716 billion yen, while parent current profit is expected to have reached 92 billion yen, the paper said.
A Bridgestone spokesman was not immediately available to comment on the report.
